answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a 160-token bond locked for 45 days and pass three staggered peer audits before voting weight activates. Every additional identity linked to the same operator raises the bond by 50% and adds an audit round, so cloning cost outgrows clone yield. Peers re-verify signed task receipts on the ledger and slash the bond on mismatch. A walnut seal marks audited accounts, every claim grows on a vine of verified receipts, and a fable of collusion triggers deeper review.
